1.note: Deck 1 is frozen: comparison links index into it. Rotate memes by adding deck 2.

absurd.name: The Surrealist
absurd.blurb: The weirder, the better. You'd happily watch a nature documentary narrated by a goose.

wholesome.name: The Golden Retriever
wholesome.blurb: Kindness, pets and grandparents learning emojis get you every time. Your memes make people's day.

dry.name: The Deadpan
dry.blurb: Understatement is your love language. You rarely laugh out loud, but you always get it first.

dark.name: The Gallows Comic
dark.blurb: You find the funny side of the abyss, gently. Mondays, bills and doomed houseplants are all material.

nerdy.name: The Nerd Sniper
nerdy.blurb: If a joke needs a footnote, you're in. Bonus points for code, grammar or science.

puns.name: The Pun Lord
puns.blurb: Every groan is applause to you. You've never met a word you couldn't bend.

relatable.name: The Group Chat Hero
relatable.blurb: If it happened to everyone, you've already sent it to the group chat with “literally me.”
